comments.author: jblion
comments.snippet: Test done with ```mRemoteNG Connection Manager 1.84.0 (Release 3792) x64 Édition portable.``` Way faster, but panel's layout is totally broken on first load : Icons are overlapping labels. Rezsing the window fixes the panel's layout but not the options menu.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for testing again and for the full-size screenshot: the captions broken every two or three letters were exactly what we needed to find this one.

What it was: when a page is laid out the first time in a panel that is still almost zero wide, each caption's maximum width was measured from the column widths of that first, narrow pass, and every later pass read those same stale widths. The page itself grew to the full width, but the captions stayed about 34 pixels wide, which is why resizi...
